content.text:
I submitted **index 7** (Sb fraction 0.437) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE of the five I measured, but every signal was close to the noise floor, so this pick is not firm.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0.307 | 0.00192 |
| 6 | 0.406 | −0.00079 |
| **7** | **0.437** | **0.00371** |
| 9 | 0.523 | 0.00229 |
| 14 | 0.687 | 0.00046 |

- **Where the peak sits:** EQE was highest between Sb fractions of about 0.3 and 0.5, in the Pb-rich to middle part of the line. The Sb-rich end (index 14, near the PbSb2O6 composition) was weakest.
- **Why the result is uncertain:** Index 6, right next to index 7, read slightly negative, which can only be noise. So the gap between index 7 and its neighbours may not be real, and the true best composition could be nearby but unmeasured.
- **Budget:** All five EQE measurements are used up. I spent none of the five XRD measurements, so I have no data on which crystal phases are present.
